wrap_module_with_timeout: wrap an nn.Module with DistributedTimeoutWrapper to kill the process if no forward pass occurs within a timeout
forward_reset_heartbeat: call forward on the wrapped module to reset the heartbeat timer and delegate the input
stop_timeout_thread: call stop_timeout to gracefully terminate the heartbeat monitoring thread and join it
get_state_dict_from_wrapped: call state_dict on the wrapper to get the state dictionary from the underlying wrapped module
load_state_dict_into_wrapped: call load_state_dict on the wrapper to load model state into the underlying wrapped module
